manual:
GOAT-legal Pegasus engine (Relinquished / Thousand-Eyes).

**Game plan:** absorb the opponent's best monster twice over (Relinquished, then TER) and lock the board.

**Key cards / engine:** Black Illusion Ritual + Relinquished; Metamorphosis token → TER.

**How to pilot / combo lines:**
- **Search the ritual:** `Senju of the Thousand Hands` (search a Ritual Monster on summon) and `Sonic Bird` (search a Ritual Spell) assemble `Relinquished` + `Black Illusion Ritual` — whose text tributes "a monster … whose Level is 1 or more" [CDB], so a `Scapegoat` token or a searcher pays for it.
- **`Relinquished` absorb line:** "target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target … ATK/DEF become equal … any battle damage you take from battles involving this card inflicts equal effect damage to your opponent" [CDB] — steal their beater and turn incoming damage into burn.
- **The bigger swing:** `Metamorphosis` a `Scapegoat` token → `Thousand-Eyes Restrict`, which absorbs a monster *and* freezes the board [CDB]. `Premature Burial`/`Call of the Haunted` recycle a used Relinquished. `Thousand-Eyes Idol` is only here as searchable Fusion material — keep it to one.

**Weaknesses:** Relinquished is a Ritual — dead without both halves; `Nobleman of Crossout`/battle removal on the absorbing monster; backrow removal on your traps opens the grind.

=== EXTRA DECK ===

**One door: `Metamorphosis` — "Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same Level as the Tributed monster" [CDB].** ⚠ You run both of `Thousand-Eyes Restrict`'s printed materials — it reads "`Relinquished` + `Thousand-Eyes Idol`" [CDB] — but there is **no `Polymerization`** in the deck, so you never actually Fusion Summon it; and `Magical Scientist` is **Forbidden** in GOAT [GF-BAN]. Tokens are legal material ("including a Sheep Token from `Scapegoat`"), Metamorphosis "cannot be activated" if no Fusion in the list matches the tributed monster's Level, and it "does not properly Summon a Fusion Monster, so you cannot use `Monster Reborn` on it afterwards" [GR].

**Fodder by Level — Lv1 (five bodies, the densest list here):** Sheep Token, `Relinquished` ×2, `Thousand-Eyes Idol`, `Sinister Serpent`, `Magician of Faith`. **Lv5 and Lv6:** nothing — your monsters stop at Level 4.

- **`Thousand-Eyes Restrict` (Lv1) is the Extra Deck here, and no deck reaches it more ways:** "the most frequent and most powerful fusion monster special summoned with Metamorphosis … it can take the opponent's best monster while locking down the field at the same time" [GF-FUS]. Besides the standard Sheep-Token line (goats in their End Phase [GW]), **a spent `Relinquished` is itself Level 1** [CDB] — Metamorphosis it into TER to keep the absorb *and* add the board freeze; `Thousand-Eyes Idol` is a Level-1 body whose only real job is being tributed. Then **absorb with priority** — in GOAT rules "when a Chain or Summon has finished resolving, the turn player can activate a fast effect *or a monster's Ignition Effect* before the opponent is allowed to respond" [GF-BASICS], so equip the instant Metamorphosis resolves, before `Book of Moon` can land; if they flip it down first, TER "needs to be face up on the field to attach a monster to itself, so its effect will fizzle" [GR]. With `Tsukuyomi` ×2 you get the loop the format is built on: "when combined with Tsukuyomi, Restrict can take full control of the board and chip in for damage until the game is won" [GF-GOAT]. And monsters equipped to TER "do not have effects and are treated as Equip Spell Cards" [GR], so it blanks what it steals — unlike `Relinquished`, TER shuts the stolen monster's effect off.
- **`Ryu Senshi` (Lv6) — no native fodder:** "the most commonly used level 6 fusion monster, and it [is] mostly used for setting up kill turns via Chaos Sorcerer+Metamorphosis" [GF-FUS]; you play neither a Chaos Sorcerer nor any other Level 6, and `Premature Burial`/`Call of the Haunted` only target *your* Graveyard [CDB], so `Snatch Steal` on an opposing Level 6 is the single route. Worth the slot when it happens: it pays 1000 LP to negate a **Normal Trap** (`Mirror Force`, `Torrential Tribute`, `Sakuretsu Armor`, `Ring of Destruction` — *not* the Counter Trap `Solemn Judgment`) and "negate[s] the effects of any Spell Card that targets this card and destroy[s] it" [CDB], walking through `Book of Moon` and `Snatch Steal` — protection your 0-ATK absorbers otherwise never get.
- **`Musician King` (Lv5) — ⚠ unverified line in *this* deck.** The one sourced reason to run a LIGHT Level-5 vanilla is Chaos fuel: "in the rare situations where you have `Snatch Steal` for your opponent's `Airknight Parshath` and need to Metamorphosis for a light monster in your graveyard for a chaos monster [it] could be the difference between winning and losing the game" [GF-FUS]. This deck plays **no Chaos monster**, so that reason does not apply, and it has no native Level 5 to tribute either. I found no sourced role for it here — treat it as cuttable (`Dark Balter the Terrible` would at least negate a Normal Spell off the same stolen Level 5 [GF-FUS]).
